app.title: Dux: Free, open-source Wayland desktop shell with file manager and theming
app.description: Dux is a lightweight Wayland compositor that provides a desktop shell, integrated file manager, and theming support for Linux.
proposed_tests: launch Dux in a sandboxed Xwayland session
verify window manager features: open file manager, change theme, create new window
measure startup time and memory usage
